decision.reasoning: The audit shows 2 fatal failures in INFORMATION AND CONFIDENTIALITY, specifically in verification procedures and confidentiality requirements. Per policy, ANY fatal failure triggers immediate escalation regardless of the 88.9% pass rate or that only 2 parameters failed. These are regulatory/compliance breaches that override all other considerations.
key_signals: Both failures in INFORMATION AND CONFIDENTIALITY category

agent_output.escalation_reason: Agent with tenure >365 days committed two FATAL confidentiality breaches by failing to verify caller identity and disclosing case information to an unauthorized third party, creating severe compliance and legal exposure
fatal_breaches: INFORMATION AND CONFIDENTIALITY - COMPLIANT TO VERIFICATION PROCEDURES - ID verification not per policy, failed to verify demographics, shared case details without verification

INFORMATION AND CONFIDENTIALITY - COMPLIANT WITH CONFIDENTIALITY REQUIREMENTS - Confidentiality requirements not met for personal and account information, shared case information with an unauthorized third party
risk_impact: Regulatory non-compliance with data protection and consumer credit privacy laws exposing organization to penalties and legal action
Unauthorized disclosure of consumer credit repair case details and personal information to third party creates liability for privacy violations
Customer trust severely compromised; potential for identity theft or misuse of disclosed information
Pattern of verification bypass by experienced agent (>365 days tenure) indicates systemic training gap requiring immediate containment
recommended_actions: Immediately suspend agent from handling live calls until investigation and remediation complete
Conduct urgent case review to identify all calls in past 30 days where verification may have been skipped or information disclosed improperly
Notify affected customer(s) whose information was disclosed to unauthorized third party and document breach per regulatory requirements
Require agent to complete mandatory refresher training on verification procedures and confidentiality requirements with 100% assessment score before call floor return
Implement 100% QA monitoring for agent's first 20 calls post-return with immediate coaching on any verification gaps
Escalate to Legal and Risk Management for regulatory reporting assessment and potential breach notification obligations
